figures.caption: Table 3: Ablation of the three structural components of the pipeline: section-wise RFC processing (S), explicit constraint extraction (C), and targeted reference expansion (R). Columns report extracted constraints (#Cons., “X” when the variant does not perform extraction), tests generated (#Tests), and differential anomalies (#Anom.). The full SCR pipeline yields the highest anomaly count on four of five protocols, producing up to 22× more anomalies than the one-shot Base.

Table 2: Bugs discovered by Extremal Testing (total 42 bugs found, 26 acked and 18 fixed). Each row is one distinct implementation-level issue triggered by an extremal test derived from an RFC constraint. Fixed: patched by maintainers. Acked: acknowledged but not yet fixed. Found: reported and under developer investigation. Bugs span missing validation, state-machine violations, and semantic misinterpretation across all five protocols we evaluated.
